title: Compliance Officer (FME) Vacancy At National Bank For Financing Infrastructure & Development
description: National Bank for Financing Infrastructure & Development invites applications for the post of Compliance Officer (FME). Name of the Post: Compliance Officer (FME) No. of Post: 01 (One) Age Limit: 55 Years Essential Qualification and Experience CA/CS/MBA/Post Graduate Degree/Diploma in Management with specialization in Finance. MBA/Post Graduate Degree/Diploma mentioned herein should be a regular full time from a University/Institution/Board recognized by Govt of India/approved by Govt. Regulator
